title: Awesome Agent Orchestration
subtitle: Coordinate agents, tools, and human decisions.
description: Frameworks and visual tools for agent coordination, durable workflows, and human approvals.
scope: Tools that compose agent steps, delegate work, or manage multi-agent workflows. Coding-agent clients and model-routing gateways are separate categories. Frameworks require application code; visual builders provide an authoring interface.
questions: Does it coordinate tool calls, multiple agents, deterministic workflow steps, or all three?
Can work pause for approval, recover from a failure, and resume with its state intact?
Which parts run locally, on your infrastructure, or in a vendor-managed service?
